name: Windows-MCP
description: MCP Server that enables Claude to interact with Windows OS
long_description:
Windows-MCP is an open-source project that enables seamless integration between AI agents and the Windows operating system. Acting as an MCP server, it bridges the gap between large language models (LLMs) and the Windows OS, allowing agents to perform tasks such as **file navigation, application control, UI interaction, QA testing, and more**.

**KEY FEATURES**
- **Seamless Windows Integration**: Interacts natively with Windows UI elements, opens applications, controls windows, simulates user input, and more.
- **Use Any LLM (Vision Optional)**: Does not rely on traditional computer vision techniques or fine-tuned models. Works with any LLM, reducing complexity and setup time.
- **Rich Toolset for UI Automation**: Includes tools for keyboard and mouse control, window management, and capturing window or UI state.
- **Lightweight & Open-Source**: Minimal dependencies with full source code available under the MIT license.
- **Customizable & Extendable**: Easily adapt or extend tools to suit custom automation workflows or AI integrations.
- **Real-Time Interaction**: Typical latency between actions ranges from `0.2` to `0.9` seconds, depending on system load, active applications, and LLM inference speed.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- **Python 3.14+**

anonymized_telemetry.title: Anonymized Telemetry
anonymized_telemetry.description: Windows-MCP collects basic usage data to help improve the MCP server. No personal information, tool arguments, or tool outputs are tracked.

profile_snapshot.title: Profile Snapshot Performance
profile_snapshot.description: Enable detailed performance logging for desktop snapshots and screenshots in the server console/logs. Useful for troubleshooting latency.

screenshot_backend.title: Screenshot Backend
screenshot_backend.description: The engine used to capture screenshots. 'auto' automatically selects the fastest available backend (DXGI -> MSS -> Pillow). Use 'pillow' if you encounter capture issues.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable debug mode to provide verbose logging for troubleshooting.

watchdog.title: UIA Focus WatchDog
watchdog.description: Run the UIAutomation focus watchdog. Off by default: it currently only emits debug logging, while costing a background thread and a UIA event subscription that can crash the server on unstable UIA environments. Tool behaviour is unaffected either way.

tools.name: ControlStatus
tools.description: Reports whether AI or the user currently controls the desktop and the remaining user-idle wait before AI control can resume. This read-only status remains available during user takeover.

tools.name: App
tools.description: Manages Windows applications with three modes: 'launch' (opens the prescribed application), 'resize' (adjusts the size/position of a named window or the active window if name is omitted), 'switch' (brings specific window into focus).

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: A comprehensive system tool for executing any PowerShell commands. Use it to navigate the file system, manage files and processes, and execute system-level operations. Capable of accessing web content, interacting with network resources, and performing complex administrative tasks.

tools.name: FileSystem
tools.description: Manages file system operations with eight modes: 'read' (read text file contents), 'write' (create/overwrite/append to files), 'copy' (copy files or directories), 'move' (move or rename), 'delete' (delete files or directories), 'list' (list directory contents), 'search' (find files by glob pattern), 'info' (get metadata like size, dates, type). Relative paths are resolved from the user's Desktop folder. Use absolute paths to access other locations.

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Captures a fast screenshot-first desktop snapshot with cursor position, active/open windows, and an image. Skips UI tree extraction for speed and should be the default first call when you mainly need visual context. Supports display=[0] or display=[0,1] using zero-based active Windows display indices. Note: the returned image may be downscaled for efficiency; when it is, multiply image coordinates by the ratio of original size to displayed size to get the actual screen coordinates for mouse actions (Click, Move, etc.).

tools.name: Snapshot
tools.description: Captures complete desktop state including: system language, focused/opened windows, interactive elements (buttons, text fields, links, menus with coordinates), and scrollable areas. Use this when you need interactive element ids, scrollable regions, or browser DOM extraction with use_dom=True. Set use_vision=True to include screenshot. Set display=[0] or display=[0,1] using zero-based active Windows display indices; omit it to keep the default full-desktop behavior.

tools.name: DisplayInventory
tools.description: Reads the active display layout and DPI metadata. Reports each display's index, device name, monitor and work-area bounds, resolution, orientation, primary flag, effective DPI, and scale.

tools.name: Click
tools.description: Performs mouse clicks at specified coordinates [x, y] or passing a UI element's label/id. Supports button types: 'left' for selection/activation, 'right' for context menus, 'middle'. Supports clicks: 0=hover only (no click), 1=single click (select/focus), 2=double click (open/activate). Provide either loc or label.

tools.name: Type
tools.description: Types text at specified coordinates [x, y] or passing a UI element's label/id. Set clear=True to clear existing text first, False to append. Set press_enter=True to submit after typing. Set caret_position to 'start' (beginning), 'end' (end), or 'idle' (default). Provide either loc or label. clear and press_enter accept only true or false. An empty text types nothing, so combine it with clear=True to just empty a field.

tools.name: Scroll
tools.description: Scrolls at coordinates [x, y], a UI element's label/id, or current mouse position if loc=None. Type: vertical (default) or horizontal. Direction: up/down for vertical, left/right for horizontal. wheel_times controls amount (1 wheel = 3-5 lines). Use for navigating long content, lists, and web pages.

tools.name: Move
tools.description: Moves mouse cursor to coordinates [x, y] or passing a UI element's label/id. Set drag=True to perform a drag-and-drop operation from the current mouse position to the target coordinates. Default (drag=False) is a simple cursor move (hover). Provide either loc or label.

tools.name: Shortcut
tools.description: Executes keyboard shortcuts using key combinations separated by +. Examples: "ctrl+c" (copy), "ctrl+v" (paste), "alt+tab" (switch apps), "win+r" (Run dialog), "win" (Start menu), "ctrl+shift+esc" (Task Manager). Use for quick actions and system commands.

tools.name: Wait
tools.description: Pauses execution for specified duration in seconds. Use when waiting for: applications to launch/load, UI animations to complete, page content to render, dialogs to appear, or between rapid actions. Helps ensure UI is ready before next interaction.

tools.name: WaitFor
tools.description: Waits until a UI condition is met by polling the accessibility tree inside a single call, avoiding repeated Snapshot calls. Conditions: text_exists, active_window, element_exists, element_enabled, focused_element. Provide text and/or window_name depending on the condition. Set use_dom=True to match browser DOM text.

tools.name: Scrape
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL or the active browser tab. By default, performs a lightweight HTTP request to the URL. If you need to extract text from the active tab's DOM within the viewport, ensure the page is open in a browser and use Snapshot with use_dom=True first, then the agent will handle extraction. Use Screenshot for the default fast visual inspection path.

tools.name: MultiSelect
tools.description: Selects multiple items such as files, folders, or checkboxes if press_ctrl=True, or performs multiple clicks if False. Pass locs (list of coordinates) or labels (list of UI element labels/ids).

tools.name: MultiEdit
tools.description: Enters text into multiple input fields at specified coordinates locs=[[x,y,text], ...] or using labels=[[label,text], ...]. Provide either locs or labels.

tools.name: Clipboard
tools.description: Manages Windows clipboard operations. Use mode="get" to read current clipboard content, mode="set" to set clipboard text.

tools.name: Process
tools.description: Manages system processes. Use mode="list" to list running processes with filtering and sorting options. Use mode="kill" to terminate processes by PID or name.

tools.name: Notification
tools.description: Sends a Windows toast notification with a title and message.

tools.name: Registry
tools.description: Accesses the Windows Registry. Use mode="get" to read a value, mode="set" to create/update a value, mode="delete" to remove a value or key, mode="list" to list values and sub-keys under a path.

tools.name: ParsePE
tools.description: Analyzes a PE file on disk: header, architecture, section table with entropy, imports, exports, resources, Authenticode signature presence, and heuristic packer/protector fingerprint (UPX, VMProtect, Themida, .NET, PyInstaller and more).

tools.name: MemoryProtectCheck
tools.description: Checks the security mitigation policies of a running process: ASLR (bottom-up randomization / force relocate images / high entropy), DEP, Control Flow Guard (CFG), and dynamic-code restrictions. Provide either pid or name.

tools.name: ProcessMonitor
tools.description: Monitors process activity. mode="snapshot" captures the current process table as a baseline, mode="diff" reports started/stopped processes since the last snapshot, mode="watch" polls for start/stop events over a duration, mode="clear" drops the stored baseline.

tools.name: PreventSleep
tools.description: Prevents the Windows system from entering sleep while the MCP server is running. mode="enable" blocks system sleep (optionally keep the display on), mode="disable" clears the block, mode="status" reports the current state.

tools.name: ScreenRecord
tools.description: Records the desktop (full screen or a region) to an MP4 video or GIF file with configurable duration, fps, region and scale. Useful for UI test evidence and demo capture.

tools.name: ElevationControl
tools.description: Manages and verifies Windows UAC / administrator privilege state. mode="status" reports UAC enablement and current elevation, mode="elevate" relaunches a program with the runas verb for user confirmation, mode="verify" checks elevation/integrity of a process by pid or name.

tools.name: ServiceControl
tools.description: Manages Windows services. mode="list" enumerates services (optionally filtered by name and running/stopped state), mode="control" with action start|stop|restart changes a service state. Service changes require administrator rights.

tools.name: EventLogReader
tools.description: Reads recent entries from the Windows Application, Security or System event log with optional level (error/warning/info) and source filters. Read-only.

tools.name: ScheduledTask
tools.description: Manages Windows scheduled tasks. mode="list" enumerates tasks, mode="run"/"end"/"delete" operate on a named task, mode="create" registers a new task with a command, schedule (ONLOGON/ONSTART/ONCE/DAILY) and start time.

tools.name: WatchFile
tools.description: Watches a file or folder for changes. First call establishes a baseline; subsequent calls wait a duration and report files added, modified or removed. mode="clear" resets the baseline. Read-only monitoring.

tools.name: NetState
tools.description: Inspects network state. mode="connections" lists active TCP/UDP connections (optionally filtered by state) with owning process names, mode="stats" summarizes adapter up/down status, link speed and RX/TX traffic. Read-only.

tools.name: StartupManager
tools.description: Manages the current user's auto-run programs (HKCU Run key). mode="list" enumerates entries, mode="add" registers a command (overwrites same name), mode="remove" deletes one. Modifying startup entries changes system state.

tools.name: EnvironmentVariables
tools.description: Manages environment variables. mode="list" enumerates (scope="user" reads the registry, scope="process" the current process), mode="set" creates or updates, mode="delete" removes. User-scope changes apply to new processes.

tools.name: SystemStatus
tools.description: Summarizes system health: CPU load and cores, memory used/total, C: disk usage, battery state, boot time and uptime. Read-only.

tools.name: ImeStatus
tools.description: Queries the active Windows keyboard layout and input language: layout KLID, display language name and language ID. Read-only; never switches layouts.

tools.name: InstalledApps
tools.description: Lists installed applications from the Windows Uninstall registry keys, with optional name filter, limit and include_hidden. Read-only.

tools.name: PowerPlan
tools.description: Manages Windows power schemes. mode="list" enumerates schemes with GUIDs, mode="active" reports the current scheme, mode="set" switches by GUID.

tools.name: WifiManager
tools.description: Inspects Wi-Fi state. mode="status" reports the current adapter state and active connection, mode="scan" lists nearby networks with authentication, encryption and signal. Read-only.

tools.name: UsbDeviceList
tools.description: Lists present plug-and-play devices, optionally filtered by class (usb, display, network, storage, bluetooth, printer, audio, keyboard, mouse). Read-only.

tools.name: SystemInfo
tools.description: Summarizes machine hardware and OS information: manufacturer, model, CPU name/clock, logical cores, physical memory, OS caption/version/architecture. Read-only.

tools.name: DriverInfo
tools.description: Lists Windows system drivers with state and start mode, optionally filtered by name. Read-only.

tools.name: FileAssociations
tools.description: Queries Windows file extension associations (.ext -> program), optionally filtered by extension. Read-only.

tools.name: HostsFile
tools.description: Reads the Windows hosts file and returns non-comment IP -> hostname entries. Read-only; entry modification is intentionally not exposed.

tools.name: UserAccounts
tools.description: Lists local Windows user accounts with full name, enabled/disabled state, SID and a marker for the current user. Read-only.

tools.name: KeyboardLayouts
tools.description: Lists installed Windows keyboard layouts with KLID, layout name/file, marking which are preloaded for the current user. Read-only.

tools.name: LocaleInfo
tools.description: Reports Windows locale information: current culture, system locale and user language list. Read-only.

tools.name: TimezoneInfo
tools.description: Reports the current Windows time zone: zone ID, display name, UTC offset and daylight-saving state. Read-only.

tools.name: StorageVolumes
tools.description: Lists mounted storage volumes with device, mount point, filesystem type and used/free capacity. Read-only.

tools.name: PrinterList
tools.description: Lists installed printers with driver, port and shared state. Read-only.

tools.name: ProcessPriority
tools.description: Reads or sets Windows process priority classes. mode="list" shows priorities of running processes, mode="set" with pid and priority (idle|below|normal|above|high; REALTIME not exposed) changes one.

tools.name: SoundDevices
tools.description: Lists sound devices with manufacturer and status. Read-only.

tools.name: NetworkShares
tools.description: Lists shared folders on this machine with name, path, description and share type. Read-only.

tools.name: FirewallStatus
tools.description: Reports Windows Defender Firewall profile states: per-profile enable state and inbound/outbound default action. Read-only.

tools.name: CertificateInfo
tools.description: Lists certificates in the current user's stores (store="my" personal, "root" trusted roots, "ca" intermediate) with subject, issuer, expiry and thumbprint. Read-only.

tools.name: DisplayBrightness
tools.description: Reports the current display brightness percentage via WMI (WmiMonitorBrightness). Read-only.

tools.name: HardwareInventory
tools.description: Reports hardware details: memory modules (capacity/speed/manufacturer), graphics adapters (name/driver) and BIOS (manufacturer/version/release). Read-only.

tools.name: NetworkConfig
tools.description: Lists network adapter IP configurations: per-adapter IPv4 address, gateway and DNS. Read-only.

tools.name: PageFileInfo
tools.description: Reports page file usage (allocated/used/peak MB) and virtual memory totals. Read-only.

tools.name: SessionInfo
tools.description: Lists interactive logon sessions (quser): username, session name, state and logon time. Read-only.

tools.name: NetworkLatency
tools.description: Pings a host and reports RTT and packet loss. Sends count ICMP echo requests (default 4) with a per-packet timeout. Read-only; sends ICMP traffic to the given host.

tools.name: DnsLookup
tools.description: Resolves a hostname to IP addresses using the system DNS resolver. family="ipv4" (default), "ipv6" or "all". Read-only; performs a DNS query.

tools.name: ProcessCommandLine
tools.description: Lists running processes with their full command lines and executable paths, optionally filtered by name. Read-only; useful for diagnosing unknown or suspicious processes.

tools.name: RegistrySearch
tools.description: Searches the Windows registry for keys or values whose name contains a keyword, within HKCU\Software or HKLM\Software (bounded walk). Read-only.

tools.name: DirectorySize
tools.description: Measures the disk footprint of a folder: total size plus top-level children (depth controls listing depth). Read-only.

tools.name: TimeSyncInfo
tools.description: Reports the Windows Time service synchronization status: source, stratum, last successful sync and offset. Read-only.

tools.name: FirewallRules
tools.description: Queries Windows Firewall rules with optional name/direction/action filters. Read-only; never modifies rules.

tools.name: InstalledUpdates
tools.description: Lists installed Windows updates (hotfixes): ID, description, install date and installer. Read-only.

tools.name: ActiveWindowInfo
tools.description: Reports the foreground (active) window: handle, title, PID and owning process. Read-only.

tools.name: MousePosition
tools.description: Reports the current mouse cursor position in screen coordinates and virtual desktop size. Read-only; does not move the cursor.

tools.name: ProcessDetail
tools.description: Reports deep diagnostic metrics for one process (by pid or name): status, threads, handles, CPU%, memory, user, start time, exe path and command line. Read-only.

tools.name: RecycleBinInfo
tools.description: Reports the recycle bin total size and item count. Read-only; does not modify the bin.

tools.name: TopProcesses
tools.description: Lists the top processes by CPU percent or memory usage (RSS). by="cpu" (default) or "memory". Read-only.

tools.name: ProcessTree
tools.description: Renders the running process tree (parent -> children) as an indented list. Read-only.

tools.name: InstalledFonts
tools.description: Lists installed font families and their files. Read-only.

tools.name: NetworkAdapters
tools.description: Lists physical network adapters: name, connection ID, interface type, MAC address, link speed and enabled state. Read-only.

tools.name: WindowList
tools.description: Lists visible top-level windows with their PID and title. Read-only.

tools.name: DriveSmartInfo
tools.description: Lists physical disks with health status, media type, operational status and size. Read-only.

tools.name: ProcessIOStats
tools.description: Lists processes with the highest cumulative I/O (read/write bytes). Read-only.

tools.name: WakeSourceInfo
tools.description: Reports the last wake source and pending wake timers (powercfg). Read-only.

tools.name: PortProcessMap
tools.description: Maps network ports to owning processes (netstat -ano): protocol, local/remote address, state, PID and process name. Optional filters: protocol (TCP/UDP) and port. Read-only.

tools.name: FileHashInfo
tools.description: Computes the MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 digest of a file. Useful for verifying downloaded or distributed files. Read-only.

tools.name: SystemPerformanceScore
tools.description: Reports the Windows Experience Index (WinSAT) scores: overall, CPU, memory, disk, graphics and gaming graphics. Read-only.

tools.name: TraceRoute
tools.description: Traces the network path to a host (tracert, without DNS reverse lookups). Sends ICMP probes. Read-only.

tools.name: ProxySettings
tools.description: Reports the current user/IE proxy and WinHTTP proxy settings. Read-only; never changes proxy configuration.

tools.name: USBDeviceHistory
tools.description: Lists USB mass-storage devices that have been connected to this machine (from USBSTOR registry), with friendly name and connection sessions. Read-only.

tools.name: CrashReportList
tools.description: Lists recent Windows Error Reporting (WER) entries: crash/hang reports with age and app signature. Read-only.

tools.name: HardwareDeviceErrors
tools.description: Lists hardware devices reporting configuration errors (missing driver, disabled, cannot start). Read-only.

tools.name: RecentFiles
tools.description: Lists recently opened documents (from the RecentDocs registry). Read-only.

tools.name: BootTiming
tools.description: Reports the last boot duration and current uptime. Read-only.

tools.name: MappedDrives
tools.description: Lists network drive mappings (net use). Does not reveal credentials. Read-only.

tools.name: InstalledProgramsBySize
tools.description: Lists installed programs with their estimated install size, largest first. Read-only.

tools.name: WindowsLicenseInfo
tools.description: Reports Windows edition, build, license state and the tail of the product key. Read-only; never changes licensing.

tools.name: RemoteDesktopStatus
tools.description: Reports whether Remote Desktop is enabled and its listening port. Read-only.

tools.name: AutoLogonCheck
tools.description: Checks whether automatic logon is configured and whether a plaintext password is stored. Read-only; flags risk but modifies nothing.

tools.name: DomainMembership
tools.description: Reports whether this machine is domain-joined or in a workgroup, with computer name, domain and hardware vendor. Read-only.

tools.name: BrowserExtensions
tools.description: Lists installed Edge/Chrome browser extensions with names and versions. Read-only; useful for security reviews.

tools.name: DiskIOStats
tools.description: Reports aggregate disk I/O: read/write totals and current throughput (sampled over a short interval). Read-only.

tools.name: WindowsDefenderStatus
tools.description: Reports Windows Defender status: antivirus enabled, real-time protection, signature version/update and last scan ages. Read-only.

tools.name: NetworkThroughput
tools.description: Samples network counters to report live download/upload rates and totals. Read-only.

tools.name: ProcessAffinity
tools.description: Reports the CPU affinity mask of a process: which logical CPUs it is allowed to run on. Read-only; never changes affinity.

tools.name: NetworkConnectionSummary
tools.description: Counts TCP/UDP connections by protocol and TCP state (LISTENING, ESTABLISHED, etc). Read-only.

tools.name: SessionProcesses
tools.description: Counts running processes per Windows logon session (session ID). Read-only.

tools.name: BluetoothDevices
tools.description: Lists Bluetooth devices (paired radios and peripherals) with status. Read-only.
